text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - prod us-west-2: KV-cache paging surge + continuous-batcher regressions observed. Elevated latencies on chat/generation endpoints, multiple customers reporting timeouts. Auto-escalating to oncall.

alice.chen: Oncall here, looking now. Can anyone confirm if this started after the 03:12 deploy?

bob.martinez: I saw a spike at ~03:10 that lines up with the batcher config tweak we shipped (lowered max_batch_delay). Could be continuous-batcher generating huge KV prefixes and blowing cache.

charlie.nguyen: grabbing runtime metrics. Initial reading: one KV shard shows >92% of KV read ops, others near zero. NCCL logs show repeated stall traces around tensor-partition exchange.

alice.chen: @charlie.nguyen paste the relevant logs plz. If it's imbalanced sharding we may be hitting NCCL sync waits.

charlie.nguyen: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T03:15:02Z] kv-shard-3: recv_queue=12485 tx_queue=12 avg_latency_ms=240
[2026-03-15T03:15:02Z] gpu-2: ncclWarning: NCCL_COLL->ncclAllReduce timeout after 120s
[2026-03-15T03:15:03Z] kv-shard-3: kv_cache_size=98% eviction_rate=0.02
```

bob.martinez: that's classic uneven partitioning. Could be a hash-function regression from the batcher change — batching may be prefixing keys so they all map to same KV partition.

emma.smith: Customer impact: three enterprise customers (acme-inc, bluewave-ai, finwise) seeing 20-60% p99 token latency increases; two have active timeouts on long-chat sessions. Support tickets inbound.

support-bot: Ticket IDs: #43122, #43123, #43124. Notified reps.

alice.chen: Mitigation plan: 1) Roll back the batcher config change to restore prior hashing behavior 2) Apply KV eviction threshold increase on hot shard to force faster trimming 3) Canary a sharding fallback that routes affected requests to replica shard until fix. I'm going to attempt (1) now.

bob.martinez: For rollback: revert change in config store (kv-batcher.max_batch_delay back to 8ms) and restart continuous-batcher on canary nodes. Patch incl:
```
- continuous_batcher:
-  max_batch_delay_ms: 3
+ continuous_batcher:
+  max_batch_delay_ms: 8
```

deploy-bot: Rolling back config: deployed to canary group (3 nodes) at 03:22 UTC. Canary health: degraded -> checking.

charlie.nguyen: Meanwhile I'm applying a hotpatch to shard balancing: increase kv-shard-3.eviction_threshold from 0.8 -> 0.65 to force evictions and reduce KV residency. Patch applied to node pool, monitoring.

alice.chen: Can we also temporarily reduce continuous_batcher.max_tokens to reduce per-request key explosion? Suggest max_tokens 2048 -> 1024 for affected models. Thoughts?

bob.martinez: Agree. I'll prepare a scoped rollout for model-family: redwood-gpt-13b.

charlie.nguyen: Observing NCCL stall counts dropping after eviction threshold change, but still seeing skew in request routing. Need to confirm hashing ring state.

alice.chen: @dan.petrov can you verify the partition map and if any rebalances are stuck?

dan.petrov: On it. Quick check: one node failed a heartbeat at 03:09 and rejoined, ring index didn't fully rebalance due to a race in placement codepath. That left one shard with >1.5x weight temporarily. Creating immediate fix to force rebalance.

dan.petrov: Forcing rebalance now (cmd):
```
$ infractl kv rebalance --cluster prod-usw2 --force --shard kv-shard-3
```
Applying.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback observed: latency p99 dropped ~18% on canaries after 03:25. No errors introduced. Rolling out rollback to 20% traffic.

charlie.nguyen: After forced rebalance, partition weights normalized across GPUs. NCCL stall traces reduced to baseline. KV eviction rate increased on hot shard and cache pressure normalizing.

emma.smith: Customer update: sending note to acme-inc & bluewave-ai: we applied rollback + hotpatch. Monitoring closely.

support-bot: Customer message queued for review.

alice.chen: Current status: partial rollback deployed, hotpatch eviction threshold applied, forced shard rebalance done, temporary max_tokens reduction scheduled for affected models. Traffic routed off the hot shard via fallback policy until full rollout.

bob.martinez: Next: create a follow-up patch to make key-hashing deterministic across batcher config changes (hotfix in batcher hashing layer). Also add unit test for prefix-preserving hashing.

charlie.nguyen: Action items captured:
- revert batcher change (done)
- increase eviction threshold on hot shard (done)
- force rebalance (done)
- temporary max_tokens limit (in progress)
- add persistent monitoring alert for shard imbalance (todo)

alice.chen: Handing off to @dan.petrov for overnight watch and postmortem. I'll stay for 30m to help any fallout then sign off.

dan.petrov: Taking over. I will monitor NCCL counters, KV eviction metrics, and pagefile/paging rates. Reaching out if anything flares. :thumbsup:

emma.smith: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and track support tickets.

alice.chen: Thanks everyone. Please add any error traces or reproductions to this thread. We'll schedule a 30-minute postmortem at 10:00 UTC tomorrow.

dan.petrov: Noted. If anyone needs to reach me overnight pager: @dan.petrov oncall.

deploy-bot: Full rollback to 100% traffic completed at 03:41 UTC. Health checks passing.

charlie.nguyen: Final check: p95/p99 back within normal band for chat endpoints. NCCL timeouts resolved. Leaving metrics dashboard open for next 2 hrs.

incident-bot: Incident closed (P1 -> mitigated). Postmortem scheduled.

alice.chen: Closing thread. Great triage and quick rollback. We'll follow up with permanent fixes in eng-runtime and batcher subsystems. :tada:
